purpose: Manually curated holdout pairs of SPEC 17.2: not used to tune the current optimization.
protocol: No optimization or generator work may read the pairs.
A release evaluation may use them once, after tuning freezes, and must record that use in its benchmark result record.
Pairs may be added; existing pairs never change.

pairs.name: claim-shift
pairs.review_note: One count advances from 3 of 4 to 4 of 5; every other line is identical. The change must surface as a claim change, not as prose noise.

pairs.name: link-swap
pairs.review_note: The archive-guide destination changes while its label and sentence stay identical; the second link must not move.

pairs.name: pure-reflow
pairs.review_note: The same words, once wrapped at 72 columns and once as one line per paragraph. No reader-visible content change; every changed line still belongs to the review.
